title: Explicit --storage-driver fails with "database graph driver "" does not match" when storage.conf sets no driver
body:
### Issue Description

  When no `driver =` is set in any `storage.conf` (openSUSE Tumbleweed ships `# driver = "overlay"` commented out), podman records an empty graph driver in the libpod database. Once the database contains any container, pod or volume, passing the effective driver explicitly (`--storage-driver overlay`) fails:

  ```
  Error: database graph driver "" does not match our graph driver "overlay": database configuration mismatch
  ```

  `podman info` reports `overlay` for the same store.
  
  This makes `test/system/155-partial-pull.bats` "zstd chunked does not modify image content" fail on Tumbleweed (root/local). It runs `podman --storage-driver $(podman_storage_driver) …`   against the suite's default store, which earlier tests had already populated. 

See https://openqa.opensuse.org/tests/6343580/logfile?filename=podman-bats-root-local.tap.txt

  ### Steps to reproduce the issue

  On a host with no `driver =` in `/etc/containers/storage.conf`, `/usr/share/containers/storage.conf` or `~/.config/containers/storage.conf` (root, podman 6.2.0, throwaway store):

  ```bash
  T=$(mktemp -d)
  P="podman --root $T/root --runroot $T/run"
  $P volume create v1
  $P info --format '{{.Store.GraphDriverName}}'
  $P --storage-driver overlay volume ls
  $P volume ls
  ```
  
  ### Describe the results you received

  ```
  v1
  overlay
  Error: database graph driver "" does not match our graph driver "overlay": database configuration mismatch    (rc=125)
  DRIVER      VOLUME NAME
  local       v1
  ```
  
  ### Describe the results you expected

  `--storage-driver overlay` should be accepted when overlay is the driver that is already in use.

  ### Analysis

  `SQLiteState.ValidateDBConfig` (`libpod/sqlite_state.go`) substitutes an empty driver with `storage.DefaultStoreOptions().GraphDriverName`. That is the *configured* driver, which is empty   when `storage.conf` sets none, even though the store auto-selects one. The row is therefore written with `GraphDriver = ""`. The existing "database uses empty-string graph driver,  substituting default" fallback substitutes the same empty string. The comparison against an explicit `--storage-driver` then fails.

  Fedora's `storage.conf` sets `driver = "overlay"`, so the row holds `overlay` and the check passes there.

  Possible fixes: record and compare the driver actually in use (`store.GraphDriverName()`), or treat an empty DB value as matching any driver.

  ### Podman in a container

  No

  ### Privileged Or Rootless

  Root.

  ### Upstream Latest Release

  Yes (6.2.0)

  ### Additional environment details

  openSUSE Tumbleweed, `podman-6.2.0-3.1`, `libcontainers-common-20260915-1.1`.
